body.statement: Every cell of \(\mathfrak W_\delta(a)\) fixes the full midrank vector, every value \(T(z,b)\), and every indicator in \(p(a,b)\). Hence \(P_\delta(a)\) is a maximum over the finite complete weak-order complex, equality faces included, and is attained. If the observed outcomes are rational, every nonempty cell has a rational representative of polynomial encoding length.
body.justification: This theorem converts an unbounded missing-outcome optimization into a finite exact object without discarding ties.
body.gap: Li, Sheng, and Yu obtain an extreme-completion closed form from an exchangeable assignment law together with an altered deterministic unit-index tie-breaking convention. Ordinary midranks under arbitrary explicitly listed rational assignment weights instead require the equality-inclusive chamber maximum.
body.consumer: It supplies a checkable finite certificate for exact attrition-robust testing under rerandomization and other restricted designs.
